title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Falls 2.9% on CEO Succession Concerns (Nov 18)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 2.89% to $150.96 on Nov 18, erasing an early post-earnings gain as investors weighed who will lead the company after Jensen Huang.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


Financial media tied the drop to concerns over Nvidia's CEO succession, which outweighed quarterly results that beat analyst expectations. Wednesday was the first session after the[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) . According to[Nvidia's third-quarter fiscal 2027 release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000088/q3fy27pr.htm) , revenue reached $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year earlier, and data center revenue rose 110% to $107.6 billion. The company released the figures[after the market close on Tuesday, November 17](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-18-2026/) and guided fourth-quarter revenue to $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%.


The shares were up almost 4% before the open but reversed sharply as investors faced life after Huang, as reported by[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/nvidia-stock-erases-earnings-pop-as-investors-face-life-after-jensen-huang-173547783.html) . Analysts cited in that report said new board chair Harvey Jones handled the messaging on the timeline for naming Huang's replacement poorly and lacked urgency.


Per[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/18/nvidia-stock-earnings.html) , Jones said on the earnings call that the board does not intend to reinstate Huang, who had said before the results that he was open to returning. CNBC added that the stock is down more than 13% over the past week.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Third-quarter revenue of $115.84 billion topped the $109.10 billion analysts expected, and the $130 billion fourth-quarter guide was above the $125.1 billion LSEG consensus, per CNBC.
- Nvidia raised its fiscal 2028 revenue growth outlook to 75% from 70% three months earlier, Yahoo Finance reported.
- Interim CEO Colette Kress said of the company's customers, "They are all continuing to be with us," according to CNBC.
- Nvidia held $98 billion in cash and marketable securities against about $39 billion in debt and lease liabilities at the end of the third quarter,[Investing.com](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/moody-cuts-nvidia-credit-outlook-231405579.html) reported.


### Risks


- Moody's Ratings revised its outlook on Nvidia's credit to stable from positive on Wednesday, citing governance uncertainty after Huang's departure and the lack of a formal succession plan, according to Investing.com.
- Fourth-quarter gross margin guidance of 71.0% to 72.0% sits below the third quarter's 74.8% GAAP gross margin, and the outlook assumes no data center compute revenue from China, per the company's release.
- Huang is slated for closed-door interviews with three House committees on December 1, and a House committee has asked Kress for a briefing by December 2, CNBC reported.
